parts.tooltip: List a — zero or more possible values. An empty list short-circuits (no elements to process).
(a ⟶ List b) — applied to EVERY element; each call may return zero, one, or many results
concatMap f: apply f to each element, concatenate all resulting lists.\nbind [a1,a2,a3] f  =  f(a1) ++ f(a2) ++ f(a3)
List b — all branches expanded and flattened into a single list
